name: onebot-plugin-groupguard
description: Group Guard plugin for OneBot and SnowLuma, comprehensive group management and risk control
author: 冷曦

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run arch:check:system-write:strict && npm run arch:check:risk-policy && npm run verify:action-queue && npm run verify:core-stability && npm run verify:query-contracts && npm run verify:groupguard-delivery-contract && npm run verify:intranet-shard-command && npm run verify:all-query-fast-migration && npm run verify:intranet-battle-command && npm run verify:intranet-hidden-command && npm run verify:intranet-video-command && npm run verify:contact-risk-export && npm run verify:lanzou-update && npm run verify:admin-health && npm run verify:contract-runner && npm run verify:release-safety && npm run verify:content-risk && npm run verify:group-file-mirror
scripts.build:release: npm run typecheck && npm run arch:check:system-write:strict && npm run arch:check:risk-policy && npm run verify:intranet-shard-command && npm run verify:all-query-fast-migration && npm run verify:intranet-battle-command && npm run verify:intranet-hidden-command && npm run verify:intranet-video-command && npm run verify:group-file-mirror && vite build --mode release
scripts.build:debug: npm run typecheck && npm run arch:check:system-write:strict && npm run arch:check:risk-policy && npm run verify:intranet-shard-command && npm run verify:all-query-fast-migration && npm run verify:intranet-battle-command && npm run verify:intranet-hidden-command && npm run verify:intranet-video-command && npm run verify:group-file-mirror && vite build --mode debug
scripts.build:snowluma: npm run typecheck && npm run arch:check:system-write:strict && npm run arch:check:risk-policy && npm run verify:intranet-shard-command && npm run verify:all-query-fast-migration && npm run verify:intranet-battle-command && npm run verify:intranet-hidden-command && npm run verify:intranet-video-command && npm run verify:group-file-mirror && vite build --mode snowluma
scripts.build:all: npm run build:release && npm run build:snowluma
